name: ANTLR V4-Tool
description:
1. syntax highlighting
  2. syntax error checking
  3. generates parser code; shortcut (ctrl-shift-G / meta-shift-G) but it's in Tools menu and popups. See README.md for more details

How to use

  1. Select the G4 parser file, select the syntax name, and right-click Selected
    1. 'Test Rule sqlscript' Test the current statement
    2. 'Generate ANTLR Recognizer' Generates parser code
    3. 'Configure ANTLR.....' Configure
